title: UD Croner FUPS Compliant Custom Built Polished Hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #18
description: UD Croner hi-tensile FUPS compliant polished aluminium Bullbar. Heavy duty extra depth contoured main 10mm plate channel to suit driving lights & fog lights. Main cross tubes are one piece 64mm tube through drilled uprights and recessed into the outer uprights. Tow pin and hi-tensile aluminium weight saving backing plate (as strong as steel). Driving light mounts can be fitted to customer requirements.
